What is the synchronous Apex governor limit on SOQL queries per transaction?
Synchronous Apex allows 100 SOQL queries; asynchronous allows 200. The figure people mix it up with is 150, the DML statement limit.
How many DML statements may a single Apex transaction issue?
150 DML statements per transaction. This is why bulkification matters: one statement over a collection, never one per record in a loop.
What Apex code coverage does a production deployment require?
75% org-wide, and every trigger must have some coverage. Coverage is a deployment gate, not a measure of test quality.
An Apex class declared "without sharing" does what?
Ignores the running user’s sharing rules
Runs as the Automated Process user
Refuses to compile outside a managed package
It ignores sharing rules, but NOT field-level security or object permissions — those need explicit checks such as Security.stripInaccessible or a query in user mode.
What does the @wire decorator in a Lightning Web Component do?
Registers an event listener on the DOM
Reads Salesforce data reactively through the Lightning Data Service or an Apex method
Declares a public property settable from the parent
@wire is the reactive read. @api declares a public property; @track is now only needed for mutating the internals of objects and arrays.
What is the synchronous Apex heap size limit?
6 MB synchronous, 12 MB asynchronous. Large query results held in a collection are the usual way to hit it.
What is the maximum CPU time for a synchronous Apex transaction?
10,000 ms synchronous and 60,000 ms asynchronous. Time spent waiting on the database or a callout does not count towards it.
How many records can SOQL queries retrieve in total in one transaction?
50,000 rows across all queries in the transaction. Batch Apex with a QueryLocator is the way to work over more.
How many records can DML statements process in total in one transaction?
10,000 records processed by DML per transaction, separate from the 150-statement limit.
How many HTTP callouts can one Apex transaction make?
100 callouts per transaction, with a cumulative timeout of 120 seconds across them.
Which is required of an @future method?
It must be static and return void
It must accept an sObject parameter
It must be declared in a trigger
@future methods are static, return void and take only primitives or collections of primitives — pass Ids and query again inside the method.
What can a Queueable job do that an @future method cannot?
Take non-primitive parameters and chain another job
A Queueable accepts sObjects and other complex types, returns a job Id you can monitor, and can enqueue a follow-up job.
What batch size does Database.executeBatch use when none is given?
200 records per execute() call by default; you can pass a scope of up to 2,000. Each execute() gets its own governor limits.
By default, can an Apex test read the org’s existing records?
No — only data the test creates, apart from setup objects such as users
Only records owned by the running user
Tests are isolated from org data unless annotated @IsTest(SeeAllData=true), which is best avoided: a test that depends on existing data breaks when the data changes.
What do Test.startTest() and Test.stopTest() do?
Mark which tests count towards coverage
Give the code between them a fresh set of limits, and run queued asynchronous work at stopTest
Roll back the database between the two calls
Switch the test to run as another user
Code between the two calls gets its own governor limits, and asynchronous Apex enqueued there (future, queueable, batch) completes at stopTest so the test can assert on it.
In an update trigger, which context variable holds the field values from before the change?
Trigger.old (and Trigger.oldMap) hold the previous values; Trigger.new holds the incoming ones. Comparing the two is how a trigger acts only when a field actually changed.
Can you change field values on Trigger.new in an after trigger?
Yes, and they are saved automatically
No — the records are read-only there; set fields in a before trigger instead
Only in an after insert, not an after update
In after triggers Trigger.new is read-only. Setting a field on the record being saved belongs in a before trigger (or a before-save flow), which costs no extra DML.
What does @api do in a Lightning Web Component?
Makes a property or method public so a parent can set or call it
Makes a property reactive to its internal changes
Exposes the component to the REST API
@api marks the component’s public surface. A child should not mutate an @api property it was given; it tells the parent instead.
How does a child Lightning Web Component tell its parent that something happened?
It writes to the parent’s @api property
Data flows down through properties and up through events: the child dispatches a CustomEvent and the parent listens with an on<eventname> handler.
An Apex method used with @wire must be annotated how?
Wired Apex must be @AuraEnabled(cacheable=true), which also means it may not perform DML. A method that changes data is called imperatively instead.
Which Lightning Web Component lifecycle hook runs when the component is inserted into the DOM?
connectedCallback runs on insertion and is where initial data loading usually starts. renderedCallback runs after every render, so work there must guard against repeating.
What prevents SOQL injection in dynamic SOQL built from user input?
Running the query in a future method
A bind variable is passed as a value and can never change the query’s structure. Sharing and LIMIT have nothing to do with injection.
What does WITH USER_MODE on a SOQL query enforce?
The running user’s sharing, object permissions and field-level security
Nothing at runtime — it is a code-review hint
User mode applies sharing, CRUD and field-level security of the running user to the query, and throws if an inaccessible field is requested.
What happens when Apex makes an HTTP callout after DML in the same transaction?
The DML is rolled back automatically
It fails with "You have uncommitted work pending"
The callout is queued until the transaction commits
Callouts must come before DML in a transaction. The usual fix is to move the callout to asynchronous Apex after the save.
A class declared "inherited sharing" runs with which sharing?
The sharing mode of the class that called it — with sharing when it is the entry point
The sharing of the record owner
Inherited sharing follows the caller, and defaults to with sharing when nothing calls it, which makes it the safe choice for reusable code.
Removes fields the running user cannot access from records before you use them
Deletes records the user cannot see
It returns copies of the records without the inaccessible fields, so the code can carry on instead of failing.
What does Database.insert(records, false) do differently from the insert statement?
Allows partial success: failed records are reported and the rest are saved
allOrNone = false returns a SaveResult per record; the insert statement rolls back everything on the first failure.
What do Database.setSavepoint() and Database.rollback() let you do?
Undo DML back to a chosen point in the transaction
A savepoint marks a point in the transaction; rolling back to it undoes the DML after it. Each one counts against the DML statement limit.
What does new Map<Id, Account>([SELECT Id, Name FROM Account]) give you?
A map of the queried records keyed by their Id
The map constructor keys each record by its Id — the usual way to look records up without a nested loop.
Why use a SOQL for loop such as for (Account a : [SELECT ...])?
It retrieves records in chunks of 200, keeping heap use low
The loop fetches batches as it goes, so a large result set never sits in the heap all at once.
How do you query child records together with their parent in SOQL?
A GROUP BY on the child
A subquery on the child relationship name, e.g. (SELECT Id FROM Contacts)
SOQL has no JOIN; parent-to-child is a nested SELECT on the relationship name, child-to-parent is dot notation.
What does SELECT COUNT() FROM Account return in Apex?
COUNT() with no field returns a plain integer; COUNT(Id) returns AggregateResult rows.
When is SOSL a better choice than SOQL?
Searching for text across several objects at once
SOSL searches the search index across objects and fields; SOQL queries known fields on one object tree.
Which interface must a class implement to be scheduled with System.schedule?
Schedulable requires execute(SchedulableContext). It often just starts a batch or a queueable job.
start returns the scope, execute runs per chunk with fresh limits, finish runs once at the end.
What does implementing Database.Stateful do in batch Apex?
Keeps instance variable values between execute() calls
Without it every execute() starts with fresh instance variables, so a running total would reset each chunk.
How many batch jobs can wait in the Apex flex queue?
Up to 100 jobs can be held in the flex queue; five run or are queued for processing at a time.
How many jobs can an executing Queueable enqueue?
From an asynchronous context, a Queueable can enqueue one child job, which is what keeps chains from fanning out.
Can a batch Apex execute() method call an @future method?
Future methods cannot be called from batch Apex; use a Queueable or chain work from finish() instead.
Why is one trigger per object the usual practice?
The order in which several triggers on the same event run is not guaranteed
With one trigger handing off to a handler class, the order of logic is written down instead of left to chance.
What is a common way to stop a trigger from running its logic again when its own update re-fires it?
A static variable or set checked before the logic runs
Static variables live for the transaction, so they can record which records were already handled.
How long does a static variable in Apex keep its value?
Statics are per transaction; the next request starts clean, so they are not a cache across users.
Is Trigger.newMap available in a before insert trigger?
No — the new records have no Ids yet
Ids are assigned on save, so in before insert there is Trigger.new but no newMap.
What does record.addError('message') do in a before trigger?
Blocks the save of that record and shows the message
Sends an email to the admin
addError fails just that record; with partial success the others can still save.
Creates test data once, available to every test method in the class
Records from @TestSetup are rolled back after each test and recreated in its starting state for the next, which saves time over building them per method.
How do you test Apex that makes an HTTP callout?
Tests cannot reach the network, so a mock returns the response the code should handle.
What does System.runAs() enforce in a test?
Nothing — it only changes the name
runAs applies the user's record-level access; object and field permissions are not enforced by it.
Which exception cannot be caught in Apex?
Exceeding a governor limit ends the transaction; no catch block can recover from it.
Which Apex collection holds only unique elements?
A Set ignores duplicates, which makes it the usual way to collect Ids before a query.
What does the ?. operator do in Apex?
Returns null instead of throwing when the value on its left is null
a?.b is null when a is null, which removes a whole class of NullPointerException checks.
When is @track still needed in a Lightning Web Component?
To react to changes inside an object's properties or an array's elements
All fields are reactive when reassigned; @track is only for observing mutations inside objects and arrays.
Which template directive renders a list in a Lightning Web Component?
for:each (or iterator) repeats the template per item, and each item needs a key.
Why does each item in a for:each list need a key?
So the framework can tell items apart when the list changes
A unique key lets the engine update only the rows that changed instead of re-rendering them all.
Which directive is now preferred for conditional rendering in Lightning Web Components?
lwc:if replaced if:true/if:false, which are no longer recommended.
What does Lightning Message Service let components do?
Communicate across the page, between LWC, Aura and Visualforce
Components publish and subscribe on a message channel without needing a parent-child relationship.
How does a Lightning Web Component navigate to a record page?
NavigationMixin with a standard__recordPage page reference
Page references keep navigation working across Lightning Experience, the mobile app and Experience Cloud.
Which base component builds a whole view or edit form for a record without Apex?
It uses Lightning Data Service, so it respects sharing and field-level security with no server code.
What does Lightning Web Security (or Lightning Locker) do?
Isolates components so one namespace cannot reach another's DOM or data
Components from different namespaces run in separate sandboxes on the same page.
After changing data imperatively, how do you refresh results from a wired Apex method?
Call refreshApex() on the wired result
Wired Apex results are cached; refreshApex asks for fresh data for that wire.
Which wire adapter reads a record's fields through Lightning Data Service?
getRecord shares LDS's cache, so other components showing the same record stay in step.
Where do you declare where a Lightning Web Component can be placed, such as a record page?
In the targets of its .js-meta.xml file
Targets like lightning__RecordPage and lightningCommunity__Page decide where the component appears in builders.
What is the daily limit on asynchronous Apex method executions?
250,000, or 200 per user licence if that is greater
Batch, future, queueable and scheduled executions all count against this rolling 24-hour limit.
